currentParagraphText: “Regarding the compensation offered for their betrayal of the Milky Way Galaxy, we have chosen to put the vast majority of resources toward rebuilding what was lost during the war. Our people on the planets the Holy Church are leaving behind are also working to hopefully establish a connection with the in-progress galactic teleportation network within the next decade. To clarify, as I received some questions regarding this, the planets shall be under the control and ownership of the Chosen of the Malefic Viper. What happens to them is up to his sole discretion.”

At least this was his first time hearing about it, and while a few in the large room did look disappointed, the big players had either known or expected this.
